title: Self-Evolving Algorithm-Design Agents: Escaping In-Context Evolutionary Stagnation via Population-Curated Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.38757v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly participating in complex real-world tasks in the form of algorithm-design agents, designing and refining algorithms. Many successful algorithm-design agents adopt pure in-context evolutionary frameworks, but they may quickly plateau in domains that require specialized knowledge. Parametric adaptation offers a way to internalize specialized knowledge, but conventional training requires abundant domain-specific corpora while high-quality algorithms are scarce in complex algorithm-design scenarios. In this paper, we propose sample-efficient parametric self-evolution where agents can explore and learn from self-generated algorithms. First, we characterize in-context evolutionary stagnation and analytically propose the Improvement Chain proposition, showing how learning successive self-generated algorithms can locally increase the likelihood of neighboring algorithms. translated_title: 自进化算法设计智能体：通过种群筛选策略优化摆脱上下文进化停滞
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正以算法设计智能体的形式越来越多地参与复杂的现实世界任务，进行算法的设计与改进。许多成功的算法设计智能体采用纯上下文进化框架，但在需要专业知识的领域中可能很快陷入停滞。参数化自适应提供了一种将专业知识内化的途径，但传统训练需要大量领域特定语料库，而在复杂的算法设计场景中高质量算法十分稀缺。在本文中，我们提出了一种样本高效的参数化自进化方法，使智能体能够从自生成的算法中进行探索与学习。首先，我们刻画了上下文进化停滞现象，并通过分析提出“改进链”命题，展示了学习连续的自生成算法如何在局部提升邻近算法的似然。基于这一局部迁移特性……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出样本高效的参数化自进化方法——种群筛选策略优化，使算法设计智能体能够通过学习自生成算法构成的“改进链”来内化专业知识，从而摆脱纯上下文进化框架的停滞困境。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes sample-efficient parametric self-evolution via population-curated policy optimization, enabling algorithm-design agents to internalize expertise by learning from chains of self-generated algorithms, thereby escaping the stagnation of pure in-context evolutionary frameworks.
